title: In iceoryx2 versions from 0.6.0 to 0.10.0, The C API getters that copy a service's hash into a… (CVE-2026-115232)
description: In iceoryx2 versions 0.6.0 through 0.10.0, certain C API getter functions that copy a service's hash into a caller-provided buffer write one byte beyond the buffer boundary when the buffer length is 40 or less. This out-of-bounds write affects the NUL terminator byte. The issue is fixed in version 0.10.1.
